scope: Bounded normal fault/recovery chain; synthetic finite model, no target execution
closed_this_round: Joined the MCU fault/recovery state machine to the Frank payload boundary and prepublish queue
Per-row provenance ledger: new_this_callback / retained_current / backup_copy / initial_unset
Quantified stale values being assigned continuous new Frank ticks (484 row/channel pairs, 2..20 ticks)
stop with a complete residual batch still consumed and published after active=0
start clears software queues but not shared current; first post-start packet can be wholly stale
whole-device reinit retains current in both prior-active branches
queue-full rejects all recovered packets while preloaded fixtures keep occupying the queue
publish failure retains the identical head for later retry; frequency=0 emits no per-row output

static_work_still_available.detail: Bind nonUSB clock_frequency_variable writers and their callers; see nonusb-timebase-crosscheck/COVERAGE_RESIDUAL.json
USB 0x08012430 side effects, all upstream config selections and RCC/PLL switch transition for both images
The chain here is USB 5.5.34.0 normal 0x3c only; 132896B nonUSB, legacy and other command/aux paths have separate reports and must not be merged
core priority, KV coordination, per-message MsgId, ACK loss and dedup semantics inside the bundled libnats
MCU 0x39 auxiliary drivers and the producer/enable conditions for the Frank 0x33 CapSense branch

needs_device_or_paired_records: Same-boot device version, board type and installed firmware/config
Paired raw LSP input and NATS output with source sequence numbers, plus DRDY/IRQ/diagnostic timing
Observed CRC/timeout frequencies, callback freshness, queue occupancy and recovery duration
Physical core clock, interrupt latency, ADC CLKIN/DRDY and achieved sample rate
Cloud ACK semantics, batch/session wrapper and what an ACK actually confirms
not_in_scope: shared-log formatting/reentrancy (separate task stopped by an automatic safety check; not retried or rephrased)
malformed payloads, corruption, exploit development or vendor binary execution
device/account/API requests, online confirmation, clinical or personal sensor data
model_limitations: Abstract body objects instead of 30,128-byte CBOR; byte-level reproduction belongs to integrated-capture-model
No core queue, KV, libnats, NATS raw_mem, uploader, TLS or cloud receiver
Events and publish return codes are explicit fixtures, not observed device behaviour
Software ticks are not wall-clock time; no preemption, concurrency or allocation-failure modelling
